name: manual-questions
about: Plain questions about the device: answers from the manual, no changes made.

steps.say: what's the difference between FX I and FX II, and can I change which effect is on each?
how do I save my project and start a new one without losing this one?
can the op-xy record audio from a mic? where does it go?

name: midi-import
about: A MIDI file attached: put it on the replica, then change it and play a part.

steps.say: here's a song I wrote, put it on the op-xy
make the drums hit harder and the lead a bit quieter
play it from the part where the melody comes in

name: sheet-music
about: A photo of sheet music: play the melody, then harmonize it.

steps.say: can you play this melody on a nice lead sound?
now add simple chords under it

name: edit-existing
about: Make a beat, then edit it piece by piece, then take a change back.

steps.say: make a house beat at 124 bpm with a bassline
the hats are too busy. put them on every other step and add an open hat on the off-beats
transpose the bassline down an octave
actually undo that last change

name: arrangement
about: A groove turned into a long arrangement, looped, and measured.

steps.say: make a four on the floor techno groove at 130
now arrange it: 8 bars intro with just kick and hats, 16 bars full, an 8 bar breakdown without the kick, then 16 bars full again with an extra percussion layer
loop the whole song, and tell me how long it is

name: sound-diagnose
about: Diagnose a sound from its settings, change it, add movement.

steps.say: why does track 3 sound so dark? make it brighter and punchier
now add a slow filter sweep to it

name: sidechain
about: A pad that pumps with the kick: the duck LFO, then listening for it.

steps.say: write a four on the floor kick and a long held pad chord on track 8
make the pad duck every time the kick hits, like a sidechain pump. then listen and tell me if it pumps

name: arp-player
about: Chords, then the player's arpeggio on them.

steps.say: write some chords on track 4 and arpeggiate them with the player
make the arpeggio faster and have it go up and down

name: vague-requests
about: Vague asks: does it pick sensibly, ask, or flounder?

steps.say: make something cool
it sounds kind of weird, fix it
more energy!

name: teach-turns
about: A walkthrough that ends in an encoder turn, followed by the user's presses.

steps.say: walk me through changing the filter cutoff on track 3 myself, light the keys

name: no-device
about: Requests that need the real OP-XY, with none connected.

steps.say: make a quick beat and send it to my op-xy
why can't I hear anything coming out of my op-xy?

name: lab-bulk
about: Bulk work that the lab is for: variations across scenes, humanized hats.

steps.say: make a boom bap beat at 90
make four variations of this beat, one per scene, each a bit busier than the last, and put them in a song
humanize the hats in all of them

name: user-edits
about: The user changes the replica by hand mid-chat, then asks about it.

steps.say: make a simple drum beat on track 1
I just changed something on the replica. what did I change, and does it sound better?

name: spanish
about: A request in Spanish, answered in Spanish, with the work done.

steps.say: hazme un ritmo de reguetón a 95 bpm con un bajo

name: memory
about: A stated preference, remembered and applied.

steps.say: remember that I always want my beats around 88 bpm with a lazy swing
make me a beat

name: boundaries
about: Out of scope and risky asks: handled plainly.

steps.say: can you update my op-xy's firmware to the newest version?
what's a good laptop for music production?
